title: Recorded measurement trends
responsibility: Builds source-size, complexity and dependency trends while keeping benchmark profiles separate.

inputs.name: harnessGrowth.index
inputs.description: HarnessIndex supplying unit growth points and revision metadata. An absent unit yields no rows, and unmatched revisions leave the row subject and timestamp empty.

inputs.name: harnessGrowth.unit
inputs.description: Unit ID whose growth points are selected from the index. Matching uses exact string equality, and an absent unit yields an empty array.

inputs.name: unitTimings.index
inputs.description: HarnessIndex supplying benchmark records. Only its benchmark entries are considered, and an empty benchmark list yields no timing rows.

inputs.name: unitTimings.unit
inputs.description: Unit ID compared with each benchmark's unit field. Matching uses exact string equality, and no matches produce an empty array.

inputs.name: signed.delta
inputs.description: Numeric delta to format, or undefined when no delta is available. Zero, undefined, and other falsy numbers produce an empty string; positive numbers receive a plus sign and other truthy numbers use String.

outputs.name: growthMetrics
outputs.description: Ordered metric keys used to read measured values and calculate deltas. The keys are source-bytes, complexity, and dependencies.

outputs.name: harnessGrowth
outputs.description: Growth rows for the selected unit, ordered oldest first according to revision positions. Missing units produce an empty array; missing metric values or prior values remain undefined, and changed reflects whether any computed delta is truthy.

outputs.name: unitTimings
outputs.description: Benchmark records whose unit exactly matches the requested unit, returned in their original order. Each matching record is returned unchanged, so distinct measurement conditions remain separate.

outputs.name: signed
outputs.description: Formatted delta string. It is empty for zero, undefined, or another falsy number, prefixes positive values with plus, and stringifies other truthy values.
